+      id: "dialogueVoices",
+      title: "Dialogue Voices",
+      content: '# Dialogue Voices\n\nEach line of [dialogue](#clientOptions-dialogue) blips once for each syllable in its speaker\'s voice, as its words appear. Give `voice` a preset\'s name, or every parameter of the synth for a voice of your own. The [Dialogue](#howTo-Dialogue) how-to shows how to say lines with `@plugins/dialogue`.\n\n```ts\napi.setClientOption(playerId, "dialogue", { line: "Welcome to my shop!", speakerName: "Shopkeeper", voice: "regular" })\n```\n\nLeave out `voice` for a silent line.\n\n## Voice presets\n\nGive `voice` a preset\'s name for a voice that suits a kind of character:\n\n- `soft`: Gentle and unhurried: the elderly, the kindly, calm animals.\n- `regular`: An everyday adult.\n- `dark`: Low, slow and falling: the sinister and the imperious.\n- `high-pitched`: Small and quick: children and little creatures.\n- `gruff`: Deep and rough: dwarves, sailors and anyone built like a wall.\n- `lively`: Bright, bouncy and fast: the eager, the cheeky and the hurried.\n- `posh`: A rising drawl with grand swoops: nobility and showmen.\n- `mechanical`: Flat and even: constructs and guardians.\n\n## Custom voices\n\nGive `voice` every parameter of the synth instead, to make a voice of your own. Characters that share a preset sound apart with a different `pitchHz` or `syllableMs`. The voice playground on the docs site\'s Dialogue Voices page starts from any preset and writes the code for what you hear.\n\n```ts\ntype SpeechSynth = {\n    waveform: "sine" | "triangle" | "square" | "sawtooth" // The tone of each blip, from the purest (sine) to the buzziest (sawtooth).\n    pitchHz: number // The voice\'s pitch, which intonation moves each word away from.\n    glideSemitones: number // How far the pitch slides over each blip; negative falls.\n    durationMs: number // How long each blip sounds.\n    attackMs: number // The fade in at the start of the blip.\n    releaseMs: number // The fade at the end of the blip, within `durationMs`.\n    lowpassHz: number | null // Darkens a bright waveform; null leaves it unfiltered.\n    volume: number // 1 is the engine\'s speech level.\n    intonation: SpeechIntonation\n    syllableMs: number // The speaking rate: each syllable takes this long, and sets when the next word appears.\n}\n\ntype SpeechIntonation = {\n    variationSemitones: number // How far each word sits from the voice\'s pitch, either way.\n    declineSemitones: number // How far the pitch falls from the first word of a sentence to its last.\n    questionRiseSemitones: number // How far the last word of a question rises.\n    exclaimLiftSemitones: number // How far a whole exclamation is lifted.\n}\n```\n\nThe game keeps each number within what it can play: a blip\'s attack and release fit within its length, for instance.\n\n### Example\n\nA gruff voice, pitched down and slowed for a giant:\n\n```ts\nconst giantVoice = {\n    waveform: "sawtooth",\n    pitchHz: 80,\n    glideSemitones: -0.8,\n    durationMs: 75,\n    attackMs: 4,\n    releaseMs: 14,\n    lowpassHz: 900,\n    volume: 0.85,\n    intonation: {\n        variationSemitones: 1.2,\n        declineSemitones: 3,\n        questionRiseSemitones: 3,\n        exclaimLiftSemitones: 2,\n    },\n    syllableMs: 70,\n}\n\napi.setClientOption(playerId, "dialogue", { line: "Who goes there?", speakerName: "Giant", voice: giantVoice })\n```\n'

+      content: '# Skins and Poses\n\nThis document lists all API-selectable skins and poses that can be used with the game API.\n\n## Usage\n\n### Changing Player Skin\n\nUse `api.changePlayerIntoSkin(playerId, part, skinName)` to change a player\'s skin:\n\n```js\napi.changePlayerIntoSkin(playerId, "body", "body_0_0")\napi.changePlayerIntoSkin(playerId, "head", "wizard") // NPC skin\n```\n\n### Setting Player Pose\n\nUse `api.setPlayerPose(playerId, pose)` to change a player\'s pose:\n\n```js\napi.setPlayerPose(playerId, "standing")\napi.setPlayerPose(playerId, "sitting")\n```\n\n---\n\n## Poses (7 poses)\n\n```\nstanding\nsitting\nzombie\ngliding\ndriving\nsleeping\nriding\n```\n\n---\n\n## Skin Parts\n\nThe following skin parts can be customised: `skin`, `hat`, `head`, `eyebrows`, `eyes`, `back`, `body`, `legs`, `shoes`\n\n---\n\n## NPC Skins (15 skins)\n\nThese are special full-body skins typically used for NPCs. + *
+ * The one default not read from the type/tier is a mob's \`riderOffset\`, which comes from its ride height.
+ *

+ * the block does not change the setting rather than that the setting is off.

+ * @param gameStartTimeMs - The time the game or match started in milliseconds since 1970, within the last 30 days - use to get event times relative to the start of the game.

+ * @param numericValue - A number the event measures, e.g. the coins earned, the round's score or the seconds it took.

+ * // Resume from where we stopped last time (or 0 on the first run)
+ * let savedLoopCounter = 0
+ *
+ * // ...

+ * for (let i = savedLoopCounter; i < 1000; i++) {
+ * 	if (api.isNearInterrupt()) {

+queueMiddleTextUpper(playerId: PlayerId, text: string | CustomTextStyling, duration: number): QueuedCommandId

+ * const myRequestId = api.addUiRequest(playerId, {
+ *   type: "standard",
+ *   title: "Do you want to join the game?",
+ * }, 5000)
+ *
+ * onUiRequestResponded = (playerId, uiRequestId, response) => {
+ *   if (uiRequestId === myRequestId) {
+ *     api.log(response)

+ * \`\`\`

+ *
+ * @param playerId The ID of the player to add the request to.

Allowed keys are letters ("KeyA" to "KeyZ"), the number row ("Digit0" to "Digit9"), arrow keys ("ArrowUp", "ArrowDown", "ArrowLeft", "ArrowRight") and "Space", shown as "_" next to the button. A key keeps its usual action too, so Space also jumps for players who have not changed their jump key.

+export type CameraSettings = DefaultCameraSettings | FixedCameraSettings | FollowCameraSettings | PathCameraSettings | FrameCameraSettings
+
+export type DefaultCameraSettings = Pick<CameraSettingsBase, "blendInMs" | "blendEasing" | "transition" | "letterbox" | "hideHud"> & { mode: "default" }
+
+export type FixedCameraSettings = CameraSettingsBase & {
+	mode: "fixed"
+	position: Pos
+	/** What to look at. Defaults to the player. */
+	lookAt?: CameraTarget
+	/** Look this way instead of at something. */
+	lookDirection?: Pos
+}
+
+export type FollowCameraSettings = CameraSettingsBase & {
+	mode: "follow"
+	/** The entity to follow. Defaults to the player. */
+	target?: EntityId
+	/** Where the camera sits relative to the target, in blocks. */
+	offset: Pos
+	/** "world" (default) keeps the offset on world axes; "target" turns it with the target's heading, +z ahead of the target. */
+	offsetSpace?: CameraOffsetSpace
+	/** What to look at. Defaults to the target. */
+	lookAt?: CameraTarget
+	lookDirection?: Pos
+	/** Trail behind the target by about this many ms. 0 sticks to it. */
+	smoothMs?: number
+	/** Move in towards the target rather than go through terrain between them, for side-on and chase cameras. Default false: a top-down camera would dive through treetops. */
+	avoidTerrain?: boolean
+}
+
+export type PathCameraSettings = CameraSettingsBase & {
+	mode: "path"
+	keyframes: CameraPathKeyframe[]
+	/** true (default): a smooth curve through the keyframes. false: straight lines between them. */
+	smooth?: boolean
+	/** Start again from the first keyframe after the last. */
+	loop?: boolean
+}
+
+export type FrameCameraSettings = CameraSettingsBase & {
+	mode: "frame"
+	/**
+	 * The entities and positions to keep in view. Entities the player is too far from to see, or that have left, are
+	 * left out. With none to frame, an empty list too, the camera holds where and how far it last framed, at this
+	 * camera's own angle, or frames the player if it has framed nothing yet.
+	 */
+	targets: CameraTarget[]
+	/** Compass direction the camera looks in, in degrees: 0 looks along +z, 90 along +x. Default 0. */
+	viewHeading?: number
+	/** Degrees the camera looks down, from 0 (level) to 90 (straight down). Default 45. */
+	viewElevation?: number
+	/** Blocks of space to keep around the targets. Default 2. */
+	padding?: number
+	/** Closest the camera comes to the middle of the targets, in blocks. Default 6, or furthestDistance if that is closer. */
+	closestDistance?: number
+	/** Furthest the camera goes from the middle of the targets, in blocks, even if some targets leave the view. Default 64, or closestDistance if that is further. */
+	furthestDistance?: number
+	/**
+	 * Ease towards a new framing over about this many ms as the targets move, and round to a new angle from the frame
+	 * camera this one replaces. 0 sticks to them. Default 400.
+	 */
+	smoothMs?: number
+}
+
+export type CameraSettingsBase = {
+	/** Blend from the current view into this camera over this many ms. 0 cuts straight to it. */
+	blendInMs?: number
+	/** How the blend eases. Default "easeInOut". */
+	blendEasing?: CameraEasing
+	/** Fade into this camera through a colour instead, cutting to it under the colour: blendInMs is ignored. */
+	transition?: CameraTransition
+	/** Cinematic bars across the top and bottom of the screen while this camera is on. Presses on the bars do nothing in the world, and dragging on them doesn't turn the camera. */
+	letterbox?: boolean
+	/**
+	 * Hide the HUD while this camera is on. Nametags, dialogue, the chat being typed in, the respawn and sleeping screens,
+	 * QTEs, UI requests, touch controls and the settings button on touch screens stay.
+	 */
+	hideHud?: boolean
+	/** Field of view in degrees. Omit to keep the player's own. */
+	fov?: number
+	/**
+	 * Which way the player's body faces while this camera is on. Movement is always relative to the camera.
+	 * "movement" (default): turns to face where they walk. "camera": faces where the camera looks.
+	 * "cursor": shows the mouse cursor and faces what is under it, or what was last tapped on touch screens, aiming
+	 * blocks, hits and shots there; the mouse no longer turns the camera. For top-down and isometric games.
+	 */
+	playerFacing?: CameraPlayerFacing
+	playerLook?: CameraPlayerLook
+}
+
+export type CameraEasing = (_TypeOf["CAMERA_EASING_NAMES"])[number] | [number, number, number, number]
+
+export type CameraTransition = {
+	/** "#rrggbb". Default "#000000". A fade already showing keeps its colour until the screen clears. */
+	colour?: string
+	/** At least 200. */
+	outMs: number
+	/** Default 0. */
+	holdMs?: number
+	/** At least 200. */
+	inMs: number
+}
+
+export type CameraPlayerFacing = (_TypeOf["CAMERA_PLAYER_FACINGS"])[number]
+
+export type CameraPlayerLook = {
+	/** Degrees left and right of the aim; 180 lets the player turn all the way round. Default 0, locked. */
+	maxYaw?: number
+	/** Degrees up and down from the aim. Default 0, locked. */
+	maxPitch?: number
+	/** Once the player stops moving the mouse, ease back to the aim over this many ms. Omit to stay where they looked. */
+	returnMs?: number
+}
+
+export type CameraTarget = Pos | EntityId
+
+export type CameraOffsetSpace = (_TypeOf["CAMERA_OFFSET_SPACES"])[number]
+
+export type CameraPathKeyframe = {
+	/** When the camera reaches this keyframe, in ms from the start of the path. */
+	timeMs: number
+	position: Pos
+	/** What the camera looks at here. Without it or \`lookDirection\`, the camera looks along the path. */
+	lookAt?: CameraTarget
+	lookDirection?: Pos
+	/** Field of view here, in degrees. */
+	fov?: number
+	/** How the camera eases from this keyframe to the next. Default "linear", so smooth paths keep a steady speed. */
+	easing?: CameraEasing
+}

+export type ShopItemUserInput =
+	| { type: "text"; placeholderText?: string; wordCharsOnly?: boolean; initialValue?: string } // wordCharsOnly defaults to false. If true, only allows \w character (alphanumeric and _). initialValue always takes precedence as the text input value when set.
+	| { type: "number"; placeholderText?: string; initialValue?: string }
+	| {
+			type: "dropdown"
+			dropdownOptions: readonly (string | { option: string; cost: number })[]
+			shouldResetSelectionOnOptionsChange?: boolean // Defaults to false. If true, the selection will reset to the first option when dropdownOptions changes.
+			initialValue?: string
+			autoSubmit?: boolean // Defaults to false. If true, the dropdown will automatically submit when the user selects an option.
+	  }
+	| { type: "player"; excludedPlayers?: PlayerId[] } // Defaults to excluding the current player
+	| { type: "color"; initialValue?: string }
+
+export type SmpShopItemMeta =
+	/**
+	 * The search box. \`item\` is the player's searched item; \`extra\` and \`excluded\` adjust the creative items it finds;
+	 * \`names\` holds the names this player sees for items a game renamed
+	 */
+	| { kind: "search"; item: string | null; extra?: readonly string[]; excluded?: readonly string[]; names?: Readonly<Record<string, string>> }
+	/** A plain listing or order box for the searched item. \`held\` is how many the player has */
+	| { kind: "creator"; item: string | null; step: "quantity" | "price"; held: number; quantity?: number; fee?: SmpListingFeeRule }
+	/** A listing box for one enchanted copy, listed whole */
+	| { kind: "enchantedCreator"; item: string; quantity: number }
+	/** A market listing. \`seller\` is null for the player's own */
+	| { kind: "listing"; item: string; quantity: number; pricePerItem: number; seller: string | null; expiresAt: number }
+	/** An Instant Sell stack */
+	| { kind: "sell"; item: string; quantity: number; pricePerItem: number }
+	/** Gold from a sale, or items back from an expired listing */
+	| { kind: "collect"; type: "sold" | "expired"; item: string; quantity: number; pricePerItem: number }
+	/** One of the player's active listings */
+	| { kind: "myListing"; item: string; quantity: number; pricePerItem: number; expiresAt: number }
+	/** A buy order. \`creator\` is null for the player's own; \`held\` is how many the player could deliver; \`processing\` while a delivery to it is on its way */
+	| { kind: "order"; item: string; wanted: number; delivered: number; pricePerItem: number; creator: string | null; held: number; processing?: boolean }
+	/** One of the player's orders, or delivered items left over from one */
+	| { kind: "myOrder"; item: string; wanted: number; delivered: number; collectable: number; pricePerItem: number }
+	/** A placeholder shown when a list is empty */
+	| { kind: "empty" }

+			post: Point // When lerping away from a point, we lerp away from its post.

+export type RecursiveReadonly<T> = T extends Primitive
+	? T
+	: T extends (...args: never[]) => unknown
+		? T
+		: T extends readonly unknown[]
+			? number extends T["length"]
+				? ReadonlyArray<RecursiveReadonly<T[number]>> // T[]
+				: { readonly [K in keyof T]: RecursiveReadonly<T[K]> } // Tuple
+			: Readonly<{ [K in keyof T]: RecursiveReadonly<T[K]> }>

+	cadenceMs?: number
+	/**
+	 * ms from equipping to the first shot. A game overriding fireRate, fireRateWithHeldTouch or cadenceMs without its own
+	 * equipDelay waits the fire interval less 0.9 of cadenceMs instead
+	 */
+	equipDelay?: number
+	burstCount?: number
+	burstDelay?: number

+	altInaccuracyMovement: number

+	altYVelocityInaccuracy?: number
+	altInaccuracyFromJump?: number

+export type MobBridgeInfo = Readonly<{
+	// The block to place.
+	blockToPlace: BlockName
+	// If true, only place while stood on solid ground (decorates the surface walked over); if false, place
+	// even while airborne (lets the mob bridge a gap beneath itself).
+	mustBeGrounded: boolean
+	// Only overwrite a cell currently holding one of these blocks, so real terrain is never destroyed.
+	// Omitted means \`["Air"]\` (fill empty space only); an empty array replaces nothing at all, not even
+	// air. A cell already holding \`blockToPlace\` is skipped (would be a no-op).
+	blocksToReplace?: readonly BlockName[]
+	// Vertical offset from the cell the mob occupies. Defaults to 0 (a surface trail); -1 places beneath the
+	// mob's feet (bridging). Non-negative offsets intersect the mob, so \`blockToPlace\` must be non-solid there.
+	yOffset?: number
+	// If a |Decaying variant exists for \`blockToPlace\`, use it to turn blocks into air after \`msToDecay\` ms.
+	msToDecay?: number
+}>

+export type MobSlideInfo = Readonly<{
+	// Horizontal impulse at the start of a slide (initial speed = impulse / mass).
+	impulse: number
+	// Lowered friction the burst coasts on (below the mob's normal friction so it carries far), restored on end.
+	friction: number
+	// How long (ms) the low-friction coast lasts.
+	durationBounds: Bounds
+	// Rest (ms) after the coast ends before the next slide. Larger = fewer slides.
+	intervalBounds: Bounds
+}>
+
+export type MobJumpInfo = Readonly<{
+	// Rest (ms) between hops (a hop only fires once grounded). Larger = fewer hops.
+	intervalBounds: Bounds
+}>
+
+export type MobRandomFacingInfo = Readonly<{
+	// Weighted offsets to pick from (via getWeightedRandom); \`weight\`s are non-negative,
+	// and at least one must be greater than 0. E.g. \`[{ offset: Math.PI, weight: 2 },
+	// { offset: 0, weight: 1 }]\` faces backwards twice as often as forwards.
+	offsets: readonly Readonly<{ offset: number; weight: number }>[]
+	// Bounds (ms) between re-rolls.
+	intervalBounds: Bounds
+}>

+export type InclusiveRange<N extends number, Arr extends number[] = []> = Arr["length"] extends N
+	? Arr[number] | Arr["length"]
+	: InclusiveRange<N, [...Arr, Arr["length"]]>

+export type Bounds = Readonly<MutableBounds>

+export type MobAiState = (_TypeOf["mobAiStates"])[number]
+
+export type MobAiStateParams<TState extends MobAiState> = MobWorldView[TState]
+
+export type MobWorldView = {
+	// The mob is stood still, but it still has awareness of its environment.
+	// For example: if the mob is hostile, it will still chase and attack nearby players.
+	idle: null
+	// The mob is stood still, and it has no awareness of its environment.
+	// It will not even react if provoked.
+	disabled: null
+	// The mob is stood still (idle) and is about to turn.
+	idleBeforeTurning: null
+	// The mob has chosen a new direction at random and is turning to face it.
+	turning: null
+	// The mob is stood still (idle) and is about to walk.
+	idleBeforeWalking: null
+	// The mob is walking in the direction it is facing.
+	walking: null
+	// The mob is running away from the target lifeform.
+	runningAway: { targetId: LifeformId }
+	// The mob is chasing the target lifeform.
+	chasing: { targetId: LifeformId }
+	// A charge-attack mob is stood still, rotating at its \`turnRate\` until it faces the target,
+	// at which point it captures the target's current position and transitions to \`charging\`.
+	turningBeforeCharging: { targetId: LifeformId }
+	// A charge-attack mob is dashing straight at the position of the target captured when it
+	// entered the state, ignoring the target's live position mid-dash (so the charge is dodgeable).
+	charging: { targetId: LifeformId }
+	// The mob is following the target lifeform.
+	// It will stop if it is within the \`minFollowingDistance\` (mob setting) of the target,
+	// and teleport to the target if it is outside the \`maxFollowingDistance\` (mob setting) of the target.
+	following: { targetId: LifeformId }
+	// The mob is stood still looking at the target.
+	watching: { targetId: LifeformId }
+	// The mob is walking towards the position.
+	// It will stop if it is within the \`stoppingRadius\` (mob setting) of the position.
+	walkingToPosition: { pos: Pos }
+	// The mob is running towards the position.
+	// It will stop if it is within the \`stoppingRadius\` (mob setting) of the position.
+	runningToPosition: { pos: Pos }
+}
+
+export type MobAiStateOptions = {

+	 * Keep the mob in this state until you set another one: it never times out, ignores nearby players and doesn't
+	 * fight back when hit. It still leaves the state when the state ends itself, such as when its target leaves the
+	 * game or turns invisible, or when it is tamed. A charge can't be held: it lasts one leg as usual.
+	 */
+	hold?: boolean
+}

+export type QTEType = keyof QTEDefinitions
+
+export type QTEClientParameters<T extends QTEType = QTEType> = {
+	type: T
+	parameters: QTEParametersForType<T>
+}
+
+export type QTEParametersForType<T extends QTEType> = QTEDefinitions[T]["params"]
+
+export interface QTEDefinitions {
+	progressBar: { params: ProgressBarQteParams; state: ProgressBarQteState }
+	timedClick: { params: TimedClickQteParams; state: TimedClickQteState }
+	gravityBar: { params: GravityBarQteParams; state: GravityBarQteState }
+	precisionBar: { params: PrecisionBarQteParams; state: PrecisionBarQteState }
+	rhythmClick: { params: RhythmClickQteParams; state: RhythmClickQteState }
+}
+
+export type ProgressBarQteParams = Readonly<{
+	/** Starting progress value (0-100) @default 30 */
+	progressStartValue?: number
+	/** How much progress drains each tick while the player isn't clicking @default 0.075 */
+	progressDecreasePerTick: number
+	/** How much progress is gained per click @default 5 */
+	progressPerClick: number
+	/** If true, the QTE fails when progress reaches 0; otherwise progress clamps at 0 @default false */
+	canFail: boolean
+	/** Rich text shown as the QTE prompt @default [{ str: "Click repeatedly to complete!" }] */
+	description: CustomTextStyling
+	/** Icon displayed on the click target @default "fa-solid fa-computer-mouse" */
+	clickIcon: string
+	/** Scale multiplier for the click icon (must be > 0) @default 1 @sensibleDefault 3 */
+	scale?: number
+	/** Rotation in degrees for the click icon (must be ≥ 0) @default 15 */
+	rotation?: number
+}>
+
+export type ProgressBarQteState = {
+	progress: number
+	clickCount: number
+}
+
+export type TimedClickQteParams = Readonly<{
+	/** Duration in milliseconds the player has to click @default 3000 */
+	timeWindow: number
+	/** Icon displayed on the click target @default "fa-solid fa-computer-mouse" */
+	icon: string
+	/** Rich text shown as the QTE prompt @default [{ str: "Click to complete the QTE!" }] */
+	label: CustomTextStyling
+	/** Whether to display a countdown timer @default true */
+	showTimer: boolean
+	/** Scale multiplier for the icon (must be > 0) @default 1 @sensibleDefault 3 */
+	scale?: number
+	/** Rotation in degrees for the icon (must be ≥ 0) @default 15 */
+	rotation?: number
+	/** If true, the icon pulses with a breathing animation anchored to the centre @default false */
+	breatheCenter?: boolean
+}>
+
+export type TimedClickQteState = {
+	timeRemaining: number
+	timeWindow: number
+}
+
+export type GravityBarQteParams = Readonly<{
+	/** Starting progress value (0-100) @default 30 */
+	progressStartValue?: number
+	/** Size of the player's catch zone as a fraction of the bar (must be > 0, 0-1) @default 0.25 */
+	catchZoneSize: number
+	/** Speed at which the mover travels along the bar (must be > 0) @default 3 */
+	moverSpeed: number
+	/** How erratically the mover changes direction (higher = more unpredictable) @default 0.8 */
+	moverErraticness: number
+	/** Downward pull on the catch zone when the player isn't holding click @default 1 */
+	gravity: number
+	/** Upward force on the catch zone while the player holds click @default 1.5 */
+	riseSpeed: number
+	/** Progress gained per second while the mover is inside the catch zone @default 8 */
+	progressGainPerSecond: number
+	/** Progress lost per second while the mover is outside the catch zone @default 4 */
+	progressDrainPerSecond: number
+	/** If true, the QTE fails when progress reaches 0; otherwise progress clamps at 0 @default false */
+	canFail: boolean
+	/** Rich text shown as the QTE prompt @default [{ str: "Hold to catch!" }] */
+	description: CustomTextStyling
+	/** Icon displayed on the mover @default "Moonfish" */
+	icon?: string
+}>
+
+export type GravityBarQteState = {
+	catchZonePosition: number
+	catchZoneSize: number
+	moverPosition: number
+	progress: number
+	isCatching: boolean
+}
+
+export type PrecisionBarQteParams = Readonly<{
+	/** Speed of the marker in full bar-widths per second (must be > 0, e.g. 1.0 = one full sweep per second) @default 0.5 */
+	speed: number
+	/** Fraction of the bar that counts as the success zone, centred in the middle (must be > 0, 0-1, e.g. 0.15 = 15%) @default 0.15 */
+	successZoneSize: number
+	/** Rich text shown as the QTE prompt @default [{ str: "Click when the marker is within the green zone." }] */
+	label: CustomTextStyling
+	/** Icon displayed on the marker @default "" */
+	icon?: string
+	/** Scale multiplier for the icon (must be > 0) @default 1 */
+	scale?: number
+	/** Rotation in degrees for the icon (must be ≥ 0) @default 0 */
+	rotation?: number
+}>
+
+export type PrecisionBarQteState = {
+	/** Marker position as 0–1 where 0.5 is the centre */
+	markerPosition: number
+}
+
+export type RhythmClickQteParams = Readonly<{
+	/** Number of successful clicks needed to complete the QTE (must be a positive integer) @default 5 */
+	requiredSuccesses: number
+	/** Duration in milliseconds for the outer circle to shrink from max size to centre (must be > 0) @default 1200 */
+	shrinkDurationMs: number
+	/** Fraction of the inner circle radius that counts as a successful overlap (must be > 0, 0-1, e.g. 0.15 = ±15%) @default 0.15 */
+	toleranceFraction: number
+	/** Max misses allowed before failing. If omitted, unlimited misses are permitted (must be a non-negative integer) @default 3 */
+	maxMisses?: number
+	/** Rich text shown as the QTE prompt @default [{ str: "Click when the circles align!" }] */
+	label: CustomTextStyling
+	/** Icon displayed in the centre of the circles @default "" */
+	icon?: string
+}>
+
+export type RhythmClickQteState = {
+	/** Current outer circle radius as a fraction of the max radius (1 = fully expanded, 0 = at centre) */
+	outerCircleProgress: number
+	/** Number of successful clicks so far */
+	successes: number
+	/** Number of required successes to complete */
+	requiredSuccesses: number
+	/** Number of misses so far */
+	misses: number
+	/** Result of the most recent click: null if no click yet, true if hit, false if miss */
+	lastClickResult: boolean | null
+}

+export type VehicleSeat = Readonly<{

+	localOffset: Pos

+export type SettableVehicleSettingValue<TSetting extends SettableVehicleSetting> = TSetting extends VehicleSetting
+	? VehicleSettingValue<TSetting>
+	: BlockVehicleSettingValue<TSetting>
+
+export type VehicleSetting = Exclude<keyof ResolvedPhysicsSettings<PhysicsType>, ByBlockRecordKey | "upwardImpulseOnUse">
+
+export type BlockVehicleSetting = string
+
+export type ResolvedPhysicsSettings<TPhysicsType extends PhysicsType> = DefaultPhysicsTypeSettings & AllPhysicsSettings[TPhysicsType]
+
+export type ByBlockRecordKey = string
+
+export type DefaultPhysicsTypeSettings = Readonly<{
+	/** How heavy it is. Heavier things resist being pushed around, and sink rather than float. */
+	mass: number
+	/** How much water and lava slow it down. \`-1\` uses the world's normal drag. */
+	fluidDrag: number
+	/** \`fluidDrag\` for sideways movement only. \`-1\` falls back to \`fluidDrag\`. */
+	fluidDragHorizontal: number
+	/** \`fluidDrag\` for up-and-down movement only. \`-1\` falls back to \`fluidDrag\`. */
+	fluidDragVertical: number
+	/** How hard gravity pulls it down, compared to a normal player. \`0\` = it never falls. */
+	gravityMultiplier: number
+	/** How wide it is, in blocks. */
+	width: number
+	/** How tall it is, in blocks. */
+	height: number
+	/** Whether the rider is allowed to sprint. */
+	canRun: boolean
+	/**
+	 * How hard the rider pushes off the ground when jumping, compared to a normal jump. \`0\` = cannot jump.
+	 * Multiplies the \`jumpAmount\` client option rather than replacing it, and heavier types need a bigger
+	 * value to reach the same height.
+	 */
+	jumpMultiplier: number
+	/** An upward shove the moment the rider uses the vehicle, like a balloon lifting off. \`0\` = none. */
+	upwardImpulseOnUse: number
+	/** Whether it climbs one-block steps by itself, rather than the rider jumping them. */
+	canAutoStep: boolean
+	/** Overrides \`canAutoStep\` for particular blocks, by block name. Unlisted blocks use \`canAutoStep\`. */
+	canAutoStepByBlock: Readonly<Record<BlockName, boolean>>
+	/**
+	 * Where the rider sits, as \`[x, y, z]\` blocks from the middle of the vehicle. A rideable mob defaults
+	 * to its own ride height rather than to this type's value.
+	 */
+	riderOffset: Pos
+	/** How the rider's body is posed while riding. */
+	pose: PlayerPose
+	/**
+	 * A badge shown to the rider for as long as they ride. \`null\` = none. \`icon\` is an ingame icon or an
+	 * item name. \`name\` must be one that a physics type already uses, such as \`"Driving"\` or \`"Boating"\`,
+	 * because only those are cleared again when the rider gets off.
+	 */
+	effect: { name: string; icon: string; duration?: number } | null
+	/** How quickly it slows to a stop once the rider stops steering. Bigger = stops sooner. */
+	standingFriction: number
+	/** Its top speed, as a multiplier on normal walking speed. \`0\` = it cannot move. */
+	speedMultiplier: number
+	/** An extra speed multiplier used while on solid ground. */
+	landSpeedMultiplier: number
+	/** An extra speed multiplier used while in water or lava. */
+	fluidSpeedMultiplier: number
+	/** An extra speed multiplier used while in the air. */
+	airSpeedMultiplier: number
+	/**
+	 * Extra speed multipliers for the block underfoot, by block name. Solid ground only, and stacks with
+	 * \`speedMultiplier\` and the land/fluid/air multiplier. When several listed blocks are underfoot, the
+	 * value furthest from \`1\` wins.
+	 */
+	speedMultiplierByBlock: Readonly<Record<BlockName, number>>
+	/** Caps how hard it is pushed while far below the speed it is aiming for, so it takes longer to get going. \`0\` = no cap. */
+	maxPushDistance: number
+	/** How hard steering pushes it. Bigger = it speeds up and changes direction more sharply. */
+	movementForceMultiplier: number
+	/** Turns off the usual steering-driven movement, as for a sleeping player. */
+	disableBaseMovement: boolean
+	/** Whether footstep sounds are silenced. */
+	disableFootstepSounds: boolean
+	/**
+	 * How bouncy walls are: \`0\` stops dead, \`1\` keeps all its speed. Stacks with the \`bounciness\` client
+	 * option. Rebounds have a floor speed, so slow bumps come back faster than they arrived.
+	 */
+	horizontalBounciness: number
+	/**
+	 * How bouncy the floor is: \`0\` lands flat, \`1\` bounces back as fast as it fell. Stacks with the
+	 * \`bounciness\` client option, and has the same rebound floor as \`horizontalBounciness\`.
+	 */
+	verticalBounciness: number
+	/** How fast it must hit a wall, in blocks per second, before \`horizontalBounciness\` applies. \`0\` = any contact. */
+	minHorizontalSpeedToBounce: number
+	/**
+	 * How fast it must be falling, in blocks per second, before \`verticalBounciness\` applies. \`0\` bounces
+	 * off any contact, leaving a bouncy vehicle jiggling in place.
+	 */
+	minVerticalSpeedToBounce: number
+	/** Shakes the camera when it hits a wall hard enough; it need not bounce. \`null\` = no shake. See \`ImpactCameraShakeOpts\`. */
+	horizontalImpactCameraShake: ImpactCameraShakeOpts | null
+	/** Shakes the camera when it hits a floor or ceiling hard enough; it need not bounce. \`null\` = no shake. See \`ImpactCameraShakeOpts\`. */
+	verticalImpactCameraShake: ImpactCameraShakeOpts | null
+	/**
+	 * Makes it steer like a car: left and right turn it rather than sliding it sideways. \`null\` moves
+	 * freely in any direction, like a walking player. See \`SteeringOpts\`.
+	 */
+	steering: SteeringOpts | null
+	/** Locks the direction it faces, in radians, ignoring the camera. \`null\` = it faces wherever the camera or steering points. */
+	fixedHeading: number | null
+	/** Makes it skip across water like a stone once it is fast enough. \`null\` = it floats normally. See \`FluidSkipOpts\`. */
+	fluidSkip: FluidSkipOpts | null
+	/**
+	 * Lets it fly once mid-air and descending. Supported movement types: \`GLIDING\` and \`FLOATING\`.
+	 * \`null\` = it cannot fly. See \`AirborneModeOpts\`.
+	 */
+	airborneMode: AirborneModeOpts | null
+	/** How it moves while flying. \`null\` = it steers the same way it does on the ground. See \`AirborneMovementOpts\`. */
+	airborneMovement: AirborneMovementOpts | null
+	/**
+	 * Caps how fast it falls while flying. Only used when \`airborneMovement\` is \`"heading"\`.
+	 * \`null\` = it falls at full speed. See \`FallSpeedLimitOpts\`.
+	 */
+	airborneFallSpeedLimit: FallSpeedLimitOpts | null
+}>
+
+export type AllPhysicsSettings = {
+	[0]: {}
+	[1]: {}
+	[2]: {}
+	[3]: {}
+	[4]: {}
+	[5]: {}
+	[6]: {}
+	[7]: {}
+}
+
+export type ImpactCameraShakeOpts = Readonly<{
+	/** The crash speed, in blocks per second, needed to shake at all, so small bumps are ignored. */
+	minSpeed: number
+	/** How much shake each extra block per second adds. Shake runs from \`0\` (still) to \`1\` (violent). */
+	intensityPerSpeed: number
+	/** The most shake one crash can cause. */
+	maxIntensity: number
+	/** How long the shake lasts, in milliseconds. */
+	durationMs: number
+}>
+
+export type SteeringOpts = Readonly<{
+	/** How fast it turns, in radians per second. Bigger = snappier steering and tighter corners. */
+	turnRate: number
+	/** How much speed a hard corner costs, from \`0\` (none) to \`1\` (all of it). */
+	corneringSpeedDamping: number
+	/**
+	 * How much it grips the ground. \`0\` slides sideways like a hovercraft on ice; bigger values make it
+	 * follow its nose round corners. Solid ground only, unless \`gripInFluid\` is on.
+	 */
+	gripStrength: number
+	/** Whether it also grips while floating in water, so a boat can corner like a kart. */
+	gripInFluid: boolean
+}>
+
+export type FluidSkipOpts = Readonly<{
+	/** How fast it must be going, in blocks per second, to start skipping. */
+	minSpeed: number
+	/** How much of its speed above \`minSpeed\` becomes upward launch speed. Bigger = higher skips. */
+	launchSpeedFraction: number
+	/** How snappily it leaves the water. Bigger = a sharp pop; smaller = a slow heave. */
+	launchApproachRate: number
+}>
+
+export type AirborneModeOpts = Readonly<{
+	/** Which movement type to switch to: \`GLIDING\` for gliders, \`FLOATING\` for balloons. */
+	activeMovementType: MovementType
+	/** How long the flying lasts, in milliseconds, before it drops the rider. \`null\` = no limit. */
+	durationMs: number | null
+	/** Whether the flying ending also throws the rider off, as a popping balloon does. */
+	exitsVehicleOnEnd: boolean
+}>
+
+export type AirborneMovementOpts = HeadingAirborneMovement | CameraDirectionAirborneMovement
+
+export type FallSpeedLimitOpts = Readonly<{
+	/** The fastest it may fall, in blocks per second. */
+	maxFallSpeed: number
+	/** Roughly how long, in seconds, it takes to slow back to the limit. Smaller = a firmer catch. */
+	slowDownSeconds: number
+	/** Whether to also cancel gravity while holding it back, so the limit is not slowly overpowered. */
+	compensateGravity: boolean
+}>
+
+export type HeadingAirborneMovement = Readonly<{ model: "heading" }>
+
+export type CameraDirectionAirborneMovement = Readonly<{
+	model: "cameraDirection"
+	/** The fastest it can fly. Better gliders get a bigger value, and dive and climb more sharply. */
+	maxSpeed: number
+	/** The slowest it can fly. It never stalls below this, however steeply it climbs. */
+	minSpeed: number
+	/** How much looking up or down changes its speed. Bigger = dives gain speed quickly. */
+	pitchAcceleration: number
+	/** How much drag slows it each tick. \`0\` = none. */
+	friction: number
+	/** How many ticks an outside shove - a fuel boost, or knockback - keeps its momentum before flight takes over again. */
+	impulseDecayTicks: number
+	/** How strongly it is nudged forwards, then gently downwards, so a level glider sinks slowly. */
+	biasMagnitude: number
+	/** How much leftover speed from a shove is shed each tick. */
+	excessVelocityBleedPerTick: number
+}>
+

+export type UserCallbacks = "tick" | "onClose" | "onPlayerJoin" | "onPlayerLeave" | "onPlayerJump" | "onRespawnRequest" | "playerCommand" | "onPlayerChat" | "onPlayerAttemptChangeBlock" | It\'s like sunshine in a paint pot.","questSpencerPaintBoxPearReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Pear Blocks [[Pear Block]] to go! They grow back on the low branches of the pear tree at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm.","questSpencerPaintBoxWatermelonGatherDescription":"Harvest Watermelon [[Watermelon]] at Stagstep Gardens in Manor Farm until you have 32 Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]]. They\'ll make a lovely red!","questSpencerPaintBoxWatermelonHandInDescription":"Bring the 32 Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerPaintBoxWatermelonHandedIn":"What a juicy red! Just right for my sunsets.","questSpencerPaintBoxWatermelonReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Watermelon Slices [[Watermelon Slice]] to go! Both start out in Cragrock Mines.","questSpencerDeepPurpleWaitingOn":"I\'m dreaming of a royal purple, neighbour, but Beetroot [[Beetroot]] only grows in Hearthdeep Village. Prove yourself to Elder Crag at his mine door in Cragrock Mines and he\'ll let you through. Ruby at Ruby\'s Rockpile in the Hub can show you the way there!","questSpencerDeepPurpleCompleted":"Purple and gold, fit for a king! Sapphire\'s bed in Hearthdeep Village has plenty.","questSpencerDeepPurpleRawGoldGatherDescription":"Mine Gold Ore [[Gold Ore]] in the Gilded Gallery of Cragrock Mines until you have 4 Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]].","questSpencerDeepPurpleGoldCraftDescription":"Craft your Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] into 8 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]].","questSpencerDeepPurpleGoldHandInDescription":"Bring the 8 Gold Fragments [[Gold Fragment]] to me on your island.","questSpencerDeepPurpleGoldHandedIn":"Gold leaf! Craft them from Raw Gold [[Raw Gold]] at a Workbench [[Workbench]].","questSpencerBoneWhiteDescription":"Every painting starts on a canvas, neighbour, and the best canvases are primed with bone white! Lorenzo at the Badlands in the Hub can show you the way there!","questSpencerBoneWhiteCompleted":"A proper bone white with a pearly shine! My paint box is looking wonderful, neighbour, thanks to you. Plant these Cherry Saplings [[Cherry Sapling]] on your island, and just wait till you see the blossom!","questSpencerBoneWhiteBonesGatherDescription":"Defeat the skeletons on the Scorched Flats, just outside the gate of Emberwatch Outpost in the Wild Infernos, until you have 20 Bones [[Bone]].","questSpencerBoneWhiteBonesHandInDescription":"Bring the 20 Bones [[Bone]] back to me on your island.","questSpencerBoneWhiteBonesHandedIn":"Now that\'s a proper bone white, the perfect start for any painting!","questSpencerBoneWhiteBonesReminder":"Just {{remaining}} more Bones [[Bone]] to go! Then the Combat Dummy is yours!","questSparringPartnerCompleted":"Splendid! Take this Combat Dummy. Craft 12 Maple Wood Planks [[Maple Wood Planks]] from your logs first, then bridge the gap to me.","maverickNeedLogsForBridge":"Whoa, not so fast! Put on a Wood Helmet [[Wood Helmet]] and come back to me.","miniWantsIronHelmet":"We start at the top, and that helmet is wrong. Swap it for an Iron Chestplate [[Iron Chestplate]].","miniWantsWoodGauntlets":"Head and chest are sorted. Your hands aren\'t. The leggings are the problem. Wear Wood Leggings [[Wood Leggings]].","miniWantsIronLeggings":"Good so far. The leggings are the problem. Wear Iron Leggings [[Iron Leggings]].","miniWantsWoodBoots":"Everything but the boots. Wear Wood Boots [[Wood Boots]] and we\'re finished.","miniWantsIronBoots":"Everything but the boots. Wear Iron Boots [[Iron Boots]] and we\'re finished.","miniArmourApproved":"Every piece as I\'d have it. Here\'s a chestplate with enough flourish to make Lorenzo jealous.","questNightWatchName":"The Night Watch","questNightWatchDescription":"Night patrol needs eyes that work in the dark. Take this Frost Shard [[Frost Shard]], recovered on duty, and make me a Night Vision Soup [[Night Vision Soup]].","questNightWatchCarrotsName":"Pick 2 Carrots","questNightWatchCarrots":"Pick 2 Carrots [[Carrot]] at Tillie\'s Patch, the farm in the hub. Good eyes start with good food.","questNightWatchBowlName":"Craft a Bowl [[Bowl]]","questNightWatchBowl":"Craft a Bowl [[Bowl]] from 3 Maple Wood Planks [[Maple Wood Planks]].","questNightWatchCraftName":"Craft Night Vision Soup [[Night Vision Soup]]","questNightWatchCraft":"Combine 2 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]], the Frost Shard [[Frost Shard]] and the Bowl [[Bowl]] to make the Night Vision Soup [[Night Vision Soup]]. Lost the shard? Report to me at the dungeon portal in the hub and I\'ll issue another.","questNightWatchDelivery":"Bring Watch Dog 1 Night Vision Soup [[Night Vision Soup]]","questNightWatchDeliver":"Bring the Night Vision Soup [[Night Vision Soup]] to me at the dungeon portal in the hub. Do it properly.","questNightWatchCompleted":"Patrol-ready. Wear this chestplate \u2014 it has kept three heads safe for years, and it will keep you standing longer.","questNightWatchUnavailableHint":"Not now. Come back after dark, when the work is real. Bring 2 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]] from Tillie\'s Patch.","questNightWatchPreparingHint":"Give me a moment. I\'m preparing the patrol.","questNightWatchNudge":"Watch Dog is on duty at the dungeon portal. Go and see him.","questFurRunName":"Spare Lining","questFurRunDescription":"Tillie needs fur. My patrol coat has spare lining, and I keep the trimmings. Bring me 12 Carrots [[Carrot]] for the three of us and it\'s yours.","questFurRunDelivery":"Bring Watch Dog 12 Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]]","questFurRunErrandDescription":"Pull 12 Carrots [[Carrot]] at Tillie\'s Patch, the farm in the hub. Bring them to me at the dungeon portal and the fur is yours.","questFurRunReminder":"Not yet. {{remaining}} more Raw Potato [[Raw Potato]], then we trade.","questFurRunCompleted":"Fair trade. Take the fur to Tillie, and stay warm out there.","questAncientWoodlandName":"The Ancient Woodland","questAncientWoodlandDescription":"Some of these maples still hold ancient wood. Look for logs that sparkle, low on the trunk. Bring me 16 Ancient Maple Log [[Ancient Maple Log]].","questAncientWoodlandNotYet":"Not yet. Let the grove settle.","questAncientWoodlandNudge":"Timbertooth has work in the grove. Go and see him.","questAncientWoodlandErrandDescription":"Chop sparkling logs in Timbertooth Woods, behind me. Only you can see the sparkles. None near you? Try other trees.","questAncientWoodlandReminder":"{{remaining}} more Ancient Maple Log [[Ancient Maple Log]]. Look low on the trunks for sparkles.","questAncientWoodlandCompleted":"Good. Old wood, well cut. These leggings are made from it. Light on the feet.","questAncientWoodlandDelivery":"Bring Timbertooth 16 Ancient Maple Log [[Ancient Maple Log]]","questAllGearedUpName":"All Geared Up","questAllGearedUpDescription":"Mini has strong opinions about armour. Put on a full set and let him look you over.","questAllGearedUpInspection":"Wear 5 armour pieces that pass Mini\'s inspection","questAllGearedUpErrand":"Dress for the duel! Wear a helmet, chestplate, gauntlets, leggings and boots, then show Mini. ","questAllGearedUpUnavailableHint":"A moment, my friend \u2014 Mini is still polishing his horns. Return shortly.","questAllGearedUpNudge":"Lorenzo says Mini is ready to inspect your armour, over at The Badlands.","questHardenedEvidenceName":"A Hardened Hunch","questHardenedEvidenceDescription":"I\'ve had troubling reports from the far end of The Badlands. Travellers say the Zombies there have skin like rock and fists that pound the ground hard enough to throw a person off their feet. Worse, they\'ve made a camp. Zombies wander; they don\'t settle. A wise hunter learns his quarry before he draws his blade. Bring me proof, duellist!","questHardenedEvidenceErrand":"Find the Hardened Zombies camped at the far end of The Badlands and take 3 Hardened Hearts from them. Step out of the ring when they pound the ground!","questHardenedEvidenceCollect":"Defeat Hardened Zombies for 3 Hardened Hearts","questHardenedEvidenceDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 3 Hardened Hearts","questHardenedEvidenceHandInDescription":"Bring those Hardened Hearts back to me, duellist. I must see them with my own eyes!","questHardenedEvidenceReminder":"{{remaining}} more of those Hardened Hearts, duellist. If the travellers are right, I\'d rather know sooner than later.","questHardenedEvidenceCompleted":"Hard as rock, and still beating... The travellers were right. No ordinary Zombie grows a heart like this. Something out there is changing them, and I mean to find out what. Mini won\'t believe a word of it. You\'ve done the Hub a real service, duellist.","questHardenedResearchName":"Know Your Quarry","questHardenedResearchDescription":"Those Hardened Hearts have kept me up all night, duellist. Skin like rock, fists like hammers... Whatever hardens those Zombies, I mean to understand it, and perhaps to borrow it. That calls for research! Bring me samples from the Hardened Zombies, and from ordinary Zombies to compare. Do this, and I\'ll forge you something special.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentCollect":"Defeat Hardened Zombies for 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentGather":"Defeat Hardened Zombies at the far end of The Badlands for 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]]. They flake off that rock-hard skin, and no other Zombie carries them.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentDeliver":"Bring the 6 Iron Fragments [[Iron Fragment]] back to me for study.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentReminder":"I still need {{remaining}} more Iron Fragment [[Iron Fragment]]. Only the Hardened Zombies drop them, duellist.","questHardenedResearchIronFragmentCompleted":"Iron, flaked straight off their skin! But iron alone doesn\'t walk about. Something more is at work here.","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainCollect":"Collect 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainGather":"Defeat Zombies in The Badlands for 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]]. Any Zombie will do, though Hardened Zombies drop them more often.","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainDeliver":"Bring the 3 Rotten Brains [[Rotten Brain]] back to me. Whatever you do, don\'t eat them!","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainReminder":"I still need {{remaining}} more Rotten Brain [[Rotten Brain]]. Any Zombie will do.","questHardenedResearchRottenBrainCompleted":"Brains! Let\'s see what they\'ve been thinking.","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshCollect":"Collect 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshDelivery":"Bring Lorenzo 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]]","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshGather":"Defeat Zombies in The Badlands for 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]], hardened or not. I need plenty to compare.","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshDeliver":"Bring the 16 Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]] back to me. Hold your nose!","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshReminder":"I still need {{remaining}} more Rotten Flesh [[Rotten Flesh]], duellist. Hardened or not, any Zombie will do.","questHardenedResearchRottenFleshCompleted":"Every sample accounted for! Between these and those Hardened Hearts, I\'ve learned the magic that hardens them, and worked it into good iron. Behold, the Hardened Sword! Land ten good strikes, and the next hits three times as hard.","lorenzoTripleStrikeReady":"Triple strike ready!","lorenzoSwordTripleStrike":"Triple strike!","questCompressionObsessionName":"Compression Obsession","questCompressionObsessionDescription":"I\'ve a daft idea: squash stone until it squeaks. Bring 4 of them back to me at Ruby\'s Rockpile, by the mines.","questCompressionFirstReminder":"{{remaining}} more Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]] and we\'re away. The rock is losing, friend!","questCompressionFirstDelivery":"Bring Ruby 4 Compressed Messy Stone [[Compressed Messy Stone]]","questCompressionFirstTurnIn":"Ha, heavier than it looks! Now squash those together: 2 Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]], please.","questCompressionSecondDescription":"Nine Compressed make one Extra Compressed at your island Workbench [[Workbench]]. Carry 2 down to me at Ruby\'s Rockpile, and mind your back.","questCompressionSecondReminder":"Another {{remaining}} Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]] to go. Stubborn rock? Be more stubborn!","questCompressionSecondDelivery":"Bring Ruby 2 Extra Compressed Messy Stone [[Extra Compressed Messy Stone]]","questCompressionSecondTurnIn":"Grand! One more squeeze, then. A single Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]] is all I ask.","questCompressionThirdDescription":"Nine Extra Compressed make one Super Compressed at your island Workbench [[Workbench]]. Just the one, brought down to me at Ruby\'s Rockpile, and I\'ll be happy.","questCompressionThirdReminder":"Still {{remaining}} Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]] short. The stone isn\'t going anywhere.","questCompressionThirdDelivery":"Bring Ruby 1 Super Compressed Messy Stone [[Super Compressed Messy Stone]]","questCompressionCompleted":"Would you look at that! Take this fool\'s gold pickaxe \u2014 worth nothing, smashes stone like nothing else, and now and then it digs up a better ore than the one you hit.","questCompressionUnavailableHint":"Give me a moment to clear my workbench, friend. Come back shortly.","questCompressionAvailableNudge":"Ruby has a daft idea about squashing stone. Go and see her at Ruby\'s Rockpile, by the mines.","questFlashFreezeName":"Flash Freeze","questFlashFreezeDescription":"A cold snap is coming, dear, and my old bones feel it. Perhaps you can help me save my crops. Speak to Watch Dog. He may be willing to part with some of his fur, so I can stitch you something warm.","questFlashFreezeNotYet":"Rest a while first, dear. I\'ll have something for you shortly.","questFlashFreezeNudge":"Tillie has something for you, dear. Fetch me 20 Coal [[Coal]].","questMiningCannonsCoalCollect":"Gather 20 Coal [[Coal]]","questMiningCannonsCoal":"Mine 20 Coal [[Coal]] for me at Ruby\'s Rockpile in the hub, or by the entrance to this mine, pal.","questMiningCannonsCoalDelivery":"Bring Grubnik 20 Coal [[Coal]]","questMiningCannonsCoalHandIn":"Bring your 20 Coal [[Coal]] to me by the broken bridge, pal.","questMiningCannonsCoalReminder":"{{remaining}} more Coal [[Coal]], pal. Cast in any water here in the hub.","questBowlineDarterDescription":"Catch or bring a Darter [[Darter]]. Cast in any water here in the hub.","questAnchorBendSpinedSticklebackDescription":"Catch or bring a Spined Stickleback [[Spined Stickleback]]. Pale as the moon, and strong as its cousins.","questAnchorBendBoulderBassDescription":"Catch or bring a Boulder Bass [[Boulder Bass]]. Heavy as a rock, so pull with all you have.","questAnchorBendGrassSnapperDescription":"Catch or bring a Grass Snapper [[Grass Snapper]]. It snaps quickly, so be ready.","questAnchorBendReportDescription":"Got all four? Come back and see old Blubberbeard.","questAnchorBendCompleted":"Four strong fish, and the Anchor Bend tied. Thank you, matey. Take this Anchor Rod. Thank you. Take this Fisherman\'s Rod. He\'ll help you sell your way there.","questIntoTheReachLearnedDescription":"You\'ve a real angler\'s hands now, matey. Sell what you can spare there, then pay the Portal Guardian his {{toll}} [[Gold Coin]].","questIntoTheReachPortal":"Use the blue portal to the Lantern Reach","questIntoTheReachPortalDescription":"Toll paid! Step through the blue portal at the west end of my path to reach the Lantern Reach.","questIntoTheReachFreePortalDescription":"Step through the blue portal at the west end of my path to reach the Lantern Reach.","questIntoTheReachKeeper":"Speak to Stinky at the lighthouse","questIntoTheReachKeeperDescription":"Follow the jetty from the harbour to the lighthouse on its rock. You\'ll smell old Stinky before you see him! Tell him Blubberbeard sent you, and that I\'m sorry.","questIntoTheReachMeeting":"Blubberbeard sent you? My old apprentice... Tell him there\'s nothing to forgive. Welcome to the Lantern Reach, friend. Everyone here calls me Stinky, and you\'ll soon smell why! The Lamp has been dark a long while, and the fish sleep deep without its light. But a good angler might just wake them.","keeperWickNothingToDo":"Sit a while and watch the water, friend. Upwind of me, if you like. Every ripple has a story.","keeperWickQuestGreeting":"Ah, a visitor! Come into the light, such as it is. Don\'t mind the flies, they\'re old friends.","keeperWickInventoryFull":"Your pack is full to the brim, friend. Make some room and come back.","lanternReachHush":"This water is still. Only small fry bite here until Stinky\'s lens shines on it.","questKeeperWickLensHandIn":"Ah, look at it glow! Thank you, friend.","questKeeperWickLensReport":"Report back to Stinky","questKelpwoodLensName":"The Kelpwood Lens","questKelpwoodLensDescription":"The lagoon fish still carry a little of the old light. Catch me a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]], a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]], an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]] and a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]] here in the lagoon, and their glow will relight the lens that faces Kelpwood.","questKelpwoodLensReportDescription":"Got all four? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.","questNothingToForgiveName":"Nothing to Forgive","questNothingToForgiveDescription":"The Lamp is waking at last, and its light reaches further every day. Would you carry a message for an old Keeper, friend? My apprentice never heard my answer. Tell Blubberbeard there\'s nothing to forgive, and that the Lamp burns again.","questNothingToForgiveTell":"Tell Blubberbeard in the Hub","questNothingToForgiveTellDescription":"Find Blubberbeard by his shack in the Hub and give him Stinky\'s answer.","questNothingToForgiveCompleted":"He said that? Nothing to forgive... I\'ve carried that guilt since I was a lad, matey. And the Lamp burns again! Here, take these two Glowtide Flares I\'ve kept since I left. Light one over Reach water and think of an old Keeper.","questKelpwoodLensCompleted":"Look, friend! The west lens is burning again, and its beam has reached Kelpwood. The fish there are waking already. Take my old Tidelight Rod. Its line still holds a little of the Lamp\'s light, so fish bite on it quicker and two at a time more often.","questAmethystLensName":"The Amethyst Lens","questAmethystLensDescription":"Kelpwood is waking, and its big fish glow brighter than anything in the lagoon. Catch me a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]], a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]], a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]], a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]] and an Oarfish [[Oarfish]] in Kelpwood\'s water, west across the bridge, and we\'ll light the lens that faces the Amethyst shoals.","questAmethystLensReportDescription":"Got all five? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.","questAmethystLensCompleted":"Two lenses lit! The east beam has reached the Amethyst shoals, and the crystals are humming. This Glowglass Rod has a chip of the Kelpwood lens for a float, and fish come to it sooner.","questMoonwellLensName":"The Moonwell Lens","questMoonwellLensDescription":"Now the lens that faces the Moonwell, where the oldest fish sleep. It needs the brightest catches in the Reach. Catch me an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]], a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]], a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]], a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]] and a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]] in the Amethyst shoals, east across the bridge.","questMoonwellLensReportDescription":"Got all five? Bring their light back to Stinky at the lighthouse.","questMoonwellLensCompleted":"Three beams across the water, friend! The Moonwell is stirring at last. Take the Moonwell Rod. It\'s cut from amethyst and cooled in that very pool, and the deepest fish rise to it.","questKelpwoodLensHatchetfish":"Catch or bring a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]]","questKelpwoodLensHatchetfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Hatchetfish [[Hatchetfish]]. A thin silver thing that glints when it turns. The lagoon is full of them.","questKelpwoodLensPolarflash":"Catch or bring a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]]","questKelpwoodLensPolarflashDescription":"Catch or bring a Polarflash Electron [[Polarflash Electron]]. It still sparks a little in the lagoon\'s dark water. Quick on the hook!","questKelpwoodLensAetherMinnow":"Catch or bring an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]]","questKelpwoodLensAetherMinnowDescription":"Catch or bring an Aether Minnow [[Aether Minnow]]. Pale as mist, and the gentlest bite in the lagoon.","questKelpwoodLensStoneGrouper":"Catch or bring a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]]","questKelpwoodLensStoneGrouperDescription":"Catch or bring a Stone Grouper [[Stone Grouper]]. It hides on the lagoon floor and rarely bites, so be patient.","questAmethystLensArapaima":"Catch or bring a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]","questAmethystLensArapaimaDescription":"Catch or bring a Mossback Arapaima [[Mossback Arapaima]]. Big and slow, with a back as green as the kelp it hides in.","questAmethystLensStingray":"Catch or bring a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]]","questAmethystLensStingrayDescription":"Catch or bring a Murk Stingray [[Murk Stingray]]. It glides low through the mangrove roots. Reel it in steadily.","questAmethystLensSawfish":"Catch or bring a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]]","questAmethystLensSawfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Channel Sawfish [[Channel Sawfish]]. Mind its nose! It fights hard all the way in from Kelpwood\'s channels.","questAmethystLensSturgeon":"Catch or bring a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]]","questAmethystLensOarfish":"Catch or bring an Oarfish [[Oarfish]]","questAmethystLensSturgeonDescription":"Catch or bring a Boned Sturgeon [[Boned Sturgeon]]. The oldest fish in Kelpwood, and a shy one.","questAmethystLensOarfishDescription":"Catch or bring an Oarfish [[Oarfish]]. Long as a jetty and rarely seen. Keep casting in Kelpwood\'s water, and it will come.","questMoonwellLensEel":"Catch or bring an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]]","questMoonwellLensEelDescription":"Catch or bring an Electric Eel [[Electric Eel]]. It crackles with light of its own down in the shoals. Just the thing for a lens!","questMoonwellLensDarter":"Catch or bring a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]]","questMoonwellLensDarterDescription":"Catch or bring a Shadow Darter [[Shadow Darter]]. Quick as a shadow between the crystals. Watch your float closely.","questMoonwellLensMoray":"Catch or bring a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]]","questMoonwellLensMorayDescription":"Catch or bring a Nomai Moray [[Nomai Moray]]. It hides in the crystal cracks and bites hard when it does.","questMoonwellLensDragonfish":"Catch or bring a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]]","questMoonwellLensGiantMoray":"Catch or bring a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]]","questMoonwellLensDragonfishDescription":"Catch or bring a Silver Dragonfish [[Silver Dragonfish]]. It shines like moonlight on the Amethyst shoals.","questMoonwellLensGiantMorayDescription":"Catch or bring a Giant Moray [[Giant Moray]]. The biggest hunter in the shoals, and the rarest bite of all. Patience, friend.","questTheHushName":"The Hush","questTheHushDescription":"Three lenses lit, and still the Lamp won\'t wake fully. That\'s the Hush, friend. It\'s no curse, only a great old fish that fell asleep in the Moonwell when the light went out, and the whole Reach went quiet with it. Will you call it up for me? Gently, now. It only needs waking.","questTheHushCall":"Wait for the Hush in the Moonwell without reeling in","questTheHushCallDescription":"Cast into the Moonwell, north across the bridge from the Lamp, and keep still while you wait: a tap or click reels the line in. When the Hush rises, tap to bring it up and it will swim home.","questTheHushReturn":"Return to Stinky","questTheHushReturnDescription":"The Hush is home in the deep again. Go and tell Stinky at the lighthouse.","questTheHushCompleted":"There! Do you see it? The whole Lamp is shining, friend, brighter than I\'ve seen it since I was young. The Hush was never our enemy. It only needed someone patient enough to call it up and let it be. Take these five Glowtide Flares, and fish the Moonwell whenever you like. That old fish may come up to say hello.","questLanternReachMailName":"News of the Lantern Reach","questLanternReachMailDescription":"There you are! The portal to the Lantern Reach can finally be opened. Blubberbeard grew up out there, and he\'s been staring at that portal all week. Go and ask him about it!","questAskBlubberbeardAboutReach":"Ask Blubberbeard about the Lantern Reach","questAskBlubberbeardAboutReachDescription":"Find Blubberbeard by his shack in the Hub and take on his task to reach the Lantern Reach.","kelpwoodResidentQuestGreeting":"There you are, dear. I was hoping you\'d drift by.","kelpwoodResidentInventoryFull":"Your pockets are full, dear. Make a little room, and I\'ll give you what I owe you.","questLostPoolName":"The Lost Pool","questLostPoolDescription":"When I was young, dear, there was a pool hidden among these roots, where the kelp meets the cliff. The wisps still whisper of it. Would you find it and catch 3 fish there? I\'d so like to know it\'s still alive.","questLostPoolCatch":"Catch 3 fish in Kelpwood\'s hidden pool","questLostPoolCatchDescription":"Search Kelpwood\'s west rim, behind the trees on the far side from its bridge, for a crack of hidden water. Cast into it and land 3 fish.","questLostPoolReturn":"Return to Auntie Glenda","questLostPoolReturnDescription":"The old pool is still full of fish. Go and tell Auntie Glenda among Kelpwood\'s roots.","questLostPoolCompleted":"Still full of fish, after all these years... Thank you, dear. I feel a little lighter, as if the mist has thinned. Take these Glowtide Flares, and the [[Gold Coin]] that washed into my roots.","kelpwoodResidentLampFestivalInvited":"A festival at the Lamp? Oh, dear, I haven\'t been to one in a hundred years. I\'ll drift across the water as soon as the lanterns are lit.","amethystResidentQuestGreeting":"You came back! I\'ve got a really important job for you.","amethystResidentInventoryFull":"Your bag\'s too full! Make some room, then come back. I\'ve got something for you!","questPerfectPitchName":"Perfect Pitch","questPerfectPitchDescription":"When the Lamp\'s beam shines on my crystals, the fish swim up to listen! I want to hear them sing. Catch 3 fish where the beam touches the Amethyst water, and I\'ll tune to their song.","questPerfectPitchCatch":"Catch 3 fish where the Lamp\'s beam touches the Amethyst water","questPerfectPitchCatchDescription":"Find the column of light where the Lamp\'s beam touches the Amethyst water. It drifts across the water and rests now and then, so cast into it and keep your float in its light until the bite. Land 3 fish bitten there.","questPerfectPitchReturn":"Return to Urchin","questPerfectPitchReturnDescription":"The shoal sang in the beam\'s light. Go and tell Urchin by his dock hut.","questPerfectPitchCompleted":"Listen... every crystal is singing the same song! You did it! Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]]. And tell Stinky he still hums flat. Don\'t say it was me!","amethystResidentLampFestivalInvited":"A festival? With music?! I\'ll tune every crystal on the shoals. Can I stay up for the lanterns?","moonwellResidentQuestGreeting":"Softly... oh, it\'s you. Come and sit by the well.","moonwellResidentInventoryFull":"Your pack is full... make a little room, and I\'ll give you what I promised.","questGlowtideLullabyName":"Glowtide Lullaby","questGlowtideLullabyDescription":"When the glowtide drifts over the Moonwell, the sleeping fish rise to dream in its glow. Would you catch 40 of them there for me? Then I\'ll know what they\'re dreaming, and what to sing.","questGlowtideLullabyCatch":"Catch 40 fish in a glowtide bloom on the Moonwell","questGlowtideLullabyCatchDescription":"Find a glowing glowtide bloom on the Moonwell\'s water, cast into it and land 40 fish while your float is in its glow. A Glowtide Flare calls up a bloom of your own.","questGlowtideLullabyReturn":"Return to Hesper","questGlowtideLullabyReturnDescription":"The Moonwell\'s fish rose to the glow. Go and tell Hesper at the Moonwell.","questGlowtideLullabyCompleted":"They dream of the light... every one of them. I\'ll sing them something new tonight. Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]], and keep the Moonwell glowing.","moonwellResidentLampFestivalInvited":"A festival at the Lamp... I\'ll bring my lantern, and sing the fish to sleep after. Wake me if I doze off.","pimLampFestivalInvited":"A festival?! At the Lamp?! I\'ll hang the bunting! I\'ll bake! Oh, I\'ve waited my whole life for this!","questLampFestivalInvitedBlubberbeard":"A festival at the Lamp, and old Stinky asked for me? ...Tell him I\'ll be there, matey. It\'s high time I went home.","questLampFestivalName":"The Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalDescription":"The whole Lamp is shining, friend, and every island is awake again. Time we had a Lamp Festival, like the ones I knew as a boy! Will you invite everyone for me? Start with Auntie Glenda, over on Kelpwood.","questLampFestivalRose":"Invite Rose to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalRoseDescription":"Back to the harbour now. Find Rose by her Tide Ledger and invite her to the Lamp Festival. She\'ll want to bake.","questLampFestivalGlenda":"Invite Auntie Glenda to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalGlendaDescription":"Find Auntie Glenda among Kelpwood\'s roots, west across the bridge, and invite her to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalChime":"Invite Urchin to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalChimeDescription":"Find Urchin by his dock hut on the Amethyst shoals, east across the bridge, and invite him to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalHesper":"Invite Hesper to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalHesperDescription":"Find Hesper at the Moonwell, north across the bridge, and invite her to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalBlubberbeard":"Invite Blubberbeard to the Lamp Festival","questLampFestivalBlubberbeardDescription":"Everyone in the Reach is coming. Go back through the portal to the Hub, find Blubberbeard by his shack, and invite him home to the Lamp Festival.","questLampFestivalReturn":"Return to Stinky","questLampFestivalReturnDescription":"Blubberbeard is coming home! Go and tell Stinky at the lighthouse.","questLampFestivalCompleted":"Blubberbeard\'s coming home? Oh, friend... I never stopped keeping a light on for him. Look at the Reach tonight: every island lit, and all of us together again. You did this. Take these Glowtide Flares and these [[Gold Coin]], and come to every festival we ever have.","keeperWickHushWaitShh":"Shh... Keep still and let the line rest, friend.","keeperWickHushWaitStill":"Still now. Something old is stirring...","keeperWickHushWaitNearly":"Nearly... It\'s rising to you.","keeperWickHushWaitAbandoned":"Shh... it\'s still close. Cast again and keep still.","keeperWickHushReelLost":"Oh! It slipped back down, friend. Cast again, it\'s still close.","keeperWickHushWaitInterrupted":"The Hush is still close, friend. Cast again when you\'re ready.","keeperWickKeepersChairLocked":"Not yet, friend. The Keeper\'s Chair waits until the whole Lamp is awake.","keeperWickKeepersChairWelcome":"Sit a while, friend. Turn the Lamp toward any water you\'ve lit, and it will shine a little kinder there, just for you.","keepersChairTitle":"Keeper\'s Chair","keepersChairClose":"Close the Keeper\'s Chair","keepersChairPrompt":"Sit in the Keeper\'s Chair","keepersChairRopeUp":"Climb to the lantern room","keepersChairRopeDown":"Climb down","keepersChairKelpwood":"Kelpwood","keepersChairAmethyst":"Amethyst Shoals","keepersChairMoonwell":"Moonwell","keepersChairAim":"Aim the Lamp","keepersChairAimLabel":"Aim the Lamp at {{island}}","keepersChairAimed":"Lamp aimed","keepersChairRest":"Rest the Lamp","keepersChairDark":"Lens still dark","keepersChairTideNotice":"Today\'s Tide Notice","keepersChairFavour":"Aimed water: blooms hold more rares and last longer, and the Tide Notice fish bites more often.","keepersChairAimedStatus":"The Lamp shines on {{island}}.","keepersChairRestedStatus":"The Lamp rests, shining on every island alike.","keepersChairTooFar":"Climb to the lantern room to aim the Lamp.","keepersChairNotRelit":"Relight that island\'s lens first.","keeperWickReachLogWelcome":"My old logbook, friend. It smells of bait, like me! Land the biggest of each fish and I\'ll ink it in, bright as a beam.","keeperWickReachLogPageGold":"A whole page in gold! Not even the Lamp shines that bright. Take these three Glowtide Flares, friend.","keeperWickLampLightWelcome":"Every fish you let go leaves a little light behind, friend. The Lamp keeps it safe for you.","keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseKelpwood":"A Kelpwood fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight Kelpwood\'s lens and they\'ll swim home.","keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseAmethyst":"An Amethyst Shoals fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight their lens and they\'ll swim home.","keeperWickHiddenWaterGlimpseMoonwell":"A Moonwell fish, hiding out in quiet water! Relight the Moonwell\'s lens and they\'ll swim home.","keeperWickHiddenWatersAllFound":"Every hidden water in the Reach! Even I\'d forgotten one or two. Wear all five and the armour burns Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]] to keep the lava off you, one flask at a time. Ward, Kade, Grizzlefuse, Flint and Mortimus each have a flask for you now. Then hear me out about that volcano.","questMagmawardName":"The Magmaward","questMagmawardPlate":"Win the Magmaward Chestplate at Kade\'s Tower of Doom","questMagmawardReport":"Return to Elder Ashborn","questTowerOfDoomDescription":"See that roof? Beat one of each on your way up.","questTowerOfDoomSquireDescription":"Cinder Squires hold the Tower of Doom\'s ground hall. When one lifts its burning hammer, step out of the ring before it comes down, and keep out of the fire it leaves.","questTowerOfDoomBruteDescription":"A Gauntlet Brute waits on the mezzanine above the Tower of Doom\'s hall. When it claps, jump the shockwave as it rolls across the floor.","questTowerOfDoomCuratorDescription":"Glass Curators keep the Tower of Doom\'s library, further up. If one shuts you in a glass case, hit the glass to break out.","questTowerOfDoomClimbDescription":"The seals are broken. Climb the rest of the stairs to Holt in the wizard room, beside the grey portal to the roof.","questTowerOfDoomRoofDescription":"Take the red portal beside Holt up to the roof and defeat the Doom Warlord.","questTowerOfDoomReportDescription":"The Warlord is down! Go back to Holt in the Tower of Doom\'s wizard room. The roof\'s portal takes you straight to him.","questTowerOfDoomCompleted":"Back in one piece, and with the Warlord\'s own Chestplate. Not many walk off that roof. The Warlord\'ll be back up there by tomorrow, mind. It always is.","questDailyTowerDescription":"The Doom Warlord\'s back on my roof. It always comes back. Climb up and knock it down again.","questDailyTowerClimbDescription":"Climb the Tower of Doom, or Holt\'s rope if it\'s yours, and take the red portal beside Holt up to the roof. Defeat the Doom Warlord.","questDailyTowerReportDescription":"Down it goes again! Take the roof\'s portal back down and tell Kade at the tower door.","questDailyTowerCompleted":"Good. That holds it for a day. Same again tomorrow?","questDailyTowerDone":"You\'ve done your climb for today. Bring me 20.","questHoltsRopeRivetsCollect":"Collect 20 Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]]","questHoltsRopeRivetsErrand":"Defeat the Warlord\'s guards on the Tower of Doom\'s stairs for Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]]. Have a look on your way down.","questWordOfATraderWindow":"Find the window out of the Tower of Doom","questWordOfATraderWindowDescription":"One of the Tower of Doom\'s windows, a few floors up, has a way out. Find Smuglyn and see what he sells.","questWordOfATraderCompleted":"Ah, someone who knows the back way in. Here, 5 Doom Rivets [[Doom Rivet]] on the house, to start you off. My wares change every day. After the MAGMAWARD GAUNTLETS? They\'re mine to give! Earn \'em! The pit\'s crawling with scorpions. Take these Mortar Strikes [[Red Firecracker Pebble]]: chuck one in and my mortar does the rest. BOOM! Thin out 50 for me!","questScorpPitHuntDescription":"Throw a Mortar Strike [[Red Firecracker Pebble]] into the Scorp Pit to bring Grizzlefuse\'s mortar down on it, or fight with your own weapon. Defeat 50 scorpions.","questScorpPitReportDescription":"That\'s 50! Step on the grey portal in the pit\'s floor to get back up to the fort, and tell Grizzlefuse.","questScorpPitCompleted":"KA-BOOM! Did you see \'em fly? Beautiful! Here, spotter: the Magmaward Gauntlets. Dug \'em out of the pit after a big one. Still warm! And take these Interdimensional Mortar Strikes [[Purple Firecracker Pebble]]. Throw one anywhere, ANYWHERE, and my shells come raining down through a rift right over it!","questDailyScorpDescription":"They\'ve bred back, spotter! Fresh Mortar Strikes [[Red Firecracker Pebble]], same job. You mark \'em, I shell \'em!","questDailyScorpHuntDescription":"Defeat 10 scorpions in the Scorp Pit, with Mortar Strikes [[Red Firecracker Pebble]] or your own weapon.","questDailyScorpReportDescription":"Pit\'s thinned! DEAL!","questGrizzlefuseFuelFind":"Find 5 Splash Poison Potions [[Splash Poison Potion]] in the Scorp Pit\'s egg piles","questGrizzlefuseFuelFindDescription":"Jump down into the Scorp Pit and dig a whole stack of eggs out of its big egg piles. Take the grey portal in the pit\'s floor back up to the fort, and tell Grizzlefuse.","questGrizzlefuseFuelCompleted":"All 5 found? Ha ha! Those scorpions\'ll be fuming! Good. Here. One Magmaward Fuel [[Magmaward Fuel]]. The crypt is stirring, but ask me again in a moment and I will send you down once more.","questSlayVulcanDescription":"You came through the fire? I\'m Ember. I felt a crack open in the world and followed it down. It\'s Lord Vulcan\'s doing, a wizard gone bad. He\'s been tearing it open from his tower at the bottom of the rift, and my fire only feeds him. His spells come in time, like a drum. Learn the beat and you can beat him. Bring friends if you can.","questSlayVulcanFightDescription":"Defeat Lord Vulcan in the ring at the bottom of the Molten Rift. His big spells come in time: step with the beat, or get out of the ring until they pass. Anyone fighting him beside you shares the win.","questSlayVulcanReportDescription":"Lord Vulcan is beaten! Tell Ember at the rift\'s southern edge.","questSlayVulcanCompleted":"You did it! Lord Vulcan is beaten, and the crack has gone quiet. But it isn\'t the only one. More are opening all over the land, and he wasn\'t working alone. Mortimus keeps the Shuffling Crypt there.","questMagmawardTreads":"Win the Magmaward Boots from Mortimus at the Shuffling Crypt","questShootingGalleryDescription":"I keep the Magmaward Leggings, old armour made for wading through lava. Earn them the way I did, starting small. Magma Golems climb those ribs out there. Take these 25 Pebbles [[Pebble]] and knock 3 of them into the lava.","questShootingGalleryPebblesDescription":"Throw Pebbles [[Pebble]] at the Magma Golems standing on the ends of the skeleton\'s ribs in the lava basin. Knock 3 of them off. Run out? Flint has more.","questShootingGalleryShootDescription":"Flint\'s Gallery Bow and Arrows [[Arrow]] are yours now. Shoot the Magma Golems on the skeleton\'s ribs and knock 6 of them off. Lost the bow? Flint has another.","questShootingGalleryPunchDescription":"Throw a Fireball [[Fireball]] at your feet to blast yourself up onto one of the skeleton\'s ribs, then knock 3 Magma Golems off up close, with your fists or a sword. Every golem that falls drops Fireballs [[Fireball]].","questShootingGalleryReportDescription":"Three rounds, three ways. Head back to Flint in her booth at the end of the skull\'s tunnel.","questShootingGalleryCompleted":"Up on the ribs, toe to toe with them. Bold. The Magmaward Leggings are yours. They\'ve waded through that lava more times than I can count.","questDailyGalleryDescription":"The golems are back on the ribs. Fresh Arrows [[Arrow]], same targets. Let\'s see if you\'ve gone rusty.","questDailyGalleryShootDescription":"Knock 6 Magma Golems off the skeleton\'s ribs in the lava basin, by shot, throw or punch. Lost Flint\'s Gallery Bow? She has another.","questDailyGalleryReportDescription":"That\'s six. Tell Flint in her booth.","questDailyGalleryCompleted":"Not bad at all. Same time tomorrow.","questDailyGalleryDone":"That\'s your practice done for today. Rest your arm.","questShootingGalleryName":"The Shooting Gallery","questShootingGalleryShoot":"Knock 6 Magma Golems off the skeleton\'s ribs","questShootingGalleryPebbles":"Knock 3 Magma Golems off with Pebbles [[Pebble]]","questShootingGalleryArrows":"Knock 6 Magma Golems off with Arrows [[Arrow]]","questShootingGalleryPunch":"Blast up onto a rib and knock 3 Magma Golems off up close","questShootingGalleryReport":"Return to Flint at the Shooting Gallery","questDailyGalleryName":"Target Practice","questGalleryFuelName":"Fireballs for Fuel","questGalleryFuelDescription":"Those golems drop Fireballs [[Fireball]] when they fall. Bro. That\'s a whole day of protein. You\'re a legend, and you didn\'t even get eaten.","questGlassBroProteinDone":"Protein\'s hit for today, bro. Same again tomorrow?
